rationale: All three protected limitations retain their original strength. “Both constructs were self-reported” preserves the common-method concern, including “may have inflated their association.” “Does not establish temporal ordering” is unchanged in substance, and “leaving open the possibility that exhaustion disrupts routines rather than the reverse” retains reverse causation. Recruitment remains through “a narrow set of metropolitan counseling networks” and still “may limit generalization.” The contextual-variability citation is also retained. The changes merely combine and tighten the limitations as authorized by R-1 and R-2.
